original_design: Tier1 TE-Bone and TE-Tumor: linsitinib3weeks/12uM or doxorubicin2weeks/4.16uM andvehicle;1weekcycles3daysdrug+4daysrest. Tier2 engineeredTE-Tumor: vehicle/cisplatin/dexamethasone/methotrexate/vincristine/MAP,2one-weekcycles then2weeksdrug-free recovery. Source Ewing2D comparator treated onsame regimens. These are source inputs/design, not response results.
assay_schema: GEO RNA-Seq/transcriptomic/cDNA; cell lysates with TempO-seq probes/lysis buffer and standard Illumina library protocols. Public mapped-read output link declared, not downloaded. This is expression output, not proven pathway dependency or direct viability phenotype.
method_scope_limits: Source model names/normal donor identity and per-sample time/aliquot-to-biological replicate maps absent from brief. Generic Tumor/Bone titles crosschecked with every source_name/characteristic. Linked primary XML500, not read or retried.
consequence: Real intervention/control and3D/2D assay design exists but its source-defined non-EMC conditions cannot answer new EMC biology. No numerical stage, drug ranking or washout claim transfer.
library_method_limit: RNA-Seq is the deposit library-strategy label; TempO-seq probes are explicitly named in extract protocol. This does not establish unbiased whole-transcriptome coverage or measured live recovery. No mapped-read matrix downloaded.
